Market today: The mood is mixed, but the underlying driver for your concentrated tech/chip book is strong demand, especially from AI. This is fueling significant investment in the sector.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down 48% and marked SELL, compounded by its leveraged nature. SPAL, a new leveraged position, is also deeply underwater at -57.73%. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) and their critical price levels. Also, watch for any signs of weakness in specific chip sub-sectors despite overall strong demand.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, losing positions.
plays: Your SOXL is down 48% and marked SELL. The scanner shows a potential long entry near current price (132.2-132.07, stop 131.35). Decide if you cut losses or attempt a bounce with a tight stop.
Your SPAL is down 57.73% on a new, leveraged position. The default stop at 21.38 is far from the current price of 10.63. Re-evaluate your risk on this position immediately.
Consider a new long in TSM (scanner entry 417.78-417.36, stop 415.59) to add exposure to the strong chip sector, supported by recent demand news.
